dispositions.rationale: Every recorded handoff binds the exact intent set by source_bindings.intents_digest. After intents.json changes, the original set cannot be reconstructed, so recovery cannot distinguish a benign note from a hidden or re-scoped intent (review round 4 required rejecting exactly that edit). The active platform-lifecycle delta keeps an explicit stop for a contract conflict; a changed intent set is such a change, and fresh pre-authoring then re-binds the handoffs. Recovery covers the intended case: an unchanged materialized contract with stale or unreadable pre-authoring.
